description: This Java source file defines the 'DefaultScheduledDateGenerator' class, which implements the 'ScheduledDateGenerator' interface. It provides methods to generate and adjust loan repayment schedule dates, considering holidays, working days, fixed-length constraints, and loan term variations within a microfinance or loan management system.

classes.name: DefaultScheduledDateGenerator
classes.description: Implements loan repayment schedule date generation logic, including handling holidays, weekends, loan variations, and fixed-length constraints as part of a loan management system.

methods.name: generateRepaymentPeriods
methods.description: Generates a list of repayment periods with adjusted dates considering holidays, term variations, and fixed-length constraints.

methods.name: getLastRepaymentDate
methods.description: Calculates the last possible repayment date based on loan terms and holiday adjustments.

methods.name: generateNextRepaymentDate
methods.description: Computes the next repayment date based on previous date, repayment frequency, and calendar considerations.

methods.name: applyLoanTermVariations
methods.description: Applies any specific term variations to adjust the repayment date accordingly.

methods.name: adjustRepaymentDate
methods.description: Adjusts a given repayment date to account for holidays and non-working days, returning detailed adjustment info.

methods.name: getAdjustedDateDetailsDTO
methods.description: Recursively handles date adjustments to skip holidays and non-working days, ensuring the final date complies with working calendar constraints.

methods.name: recursivelyCheckNonWorkingDaysAndHolidaysAndWorkingDaysExemptionToGenerateNextRepaymentPeriodDate
methods.description: Performs recursive checking and adjustment for non-working days, holidays, and working day exemptions to obtain a valid repayment date.

methods.name: checkAndUpdateWorkingDayIfRepaymentDateIsHolidayDay
methods.description: Checks if the date falls on a holiday and updates it to the next valid working day if needed.

methods.name: checkAndUpdateWorkingDayIfRepaymentDateIsNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Checks for non-working days and adjusts the date according to the rescheduling policies.

methods.name: getRepaymentPeriodDate
methods.description: Calculates a repayment date based on frequency, interval, and start date.

methods.name: isDateFallsInSchedule
methods.description: Determines whether a specific date falls within the scheduled repayment pattern.

methods.name: idealDisbursementDateBasedOnFirstRepaymentDate
methods.description: Calculates an ideal disbursement date based on the first repayment date and repayment frequency.

methods.name: generateNextScheduleDateStartingFromDisburseDate
methods.description: Generates the next scheduled date starting from the disbursement date.

methods.name: generateNextScheduleDateStartingFromDisburseDateOrRescheduleDate
methods.description: Generates the next schedule date considering either disbursement or reschedule date as starting point.

methods.name: generateNextRepaymentDateWhenHolidayApply
methods.description: Calculates the next repayment date when a holiday adjustment applies, considering calendar and holidays.
